name: Chia Chih
bio: Chia Chih (AD 718–772) was a T’ang official and poet. His poem here is a spring poem of sorrow.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Spring Sorrows
poems.author: Chia Chih

poems.title: 早朝大明宮 (Zao chao da ming gong)
poems.author: Chia Chih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
銀燭朝天紫陌長，禁城春色曉蒼蒼。
千條弱柳垂青鎖，百囀流鶯繞建章。
劍佩聲隨玉墀步，衣冠身惹御爐香。
共沐恩波鳳池上，朝朝染翰侍君王。
